subject.title: fix(exec): auto-approve recognized read-only boolean flags on default safe bins

question: Should OpenClaw expand the default safe-bin no-prompt approval boundary to include the curated boolean flags for cut, head, tail, tr, uniq, and wc?
rationale: Automation can verify the parser behavior, tests, and real decision-boundary proof, but it cannot decide whether the broader default exec trust boundary is acceptable product/security policy.

options.title: Approve curated built-ins
options.body: Accept the internal built-in boolean allowlist as intended behavior for stdin-only default safe bins, with no new custom config surface.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask the author to remove or adjust any flags maintainers do not want auto-approved by default before landing.

options.title: Keep current prompts
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer manual approval for these boolean forms until a broader exec approvals policy pass is done.

recommendation.title: Approve curated built-ins
recommendation.body: Accept the internal built-in boolean allowlist as intended behavior for stdin-only default safe bins, with no new custom config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The safe-bin policy and exec approval history points to steipete as the best available owner for the boundary decision.
